name: walkthrough
title: Deterministic vs probabilistic systems, sampling, temperature, and generation
description: This tour walks through the sampling tutorial: deterministic systems with reproducible output, probabilistic systems that sample from distributions, and the implications for testing and trusting AI systems.

steps.description: Deterministic function add(a, b) returns a + b. Same input always produces same output, no randomness.
Probabilistic function flip_coin uses random.choice to sample from ['heads', 'tails']. Output varies by design even with identical input.

steps.question: What are the two possible outputs of flip_coin()?

steps.description: random.choice selects one element from the list. The recorded run returned tails.
